motion: The camera does not move. Heavy rain keeps falling across the night high street. The red double-decker bus keeps driving steadily away from us down the long wet road, getting smaller and smaller, its lit top deck and red tail lights shrinking into the rain and the distance, until it is a small red glow far down the street. Its red reflections trail on the wet tarmac. A few people with umbrellas keep walking along the pavement. The shop signs stay exactly as they are. The camera does not move.
